_doc: Per-app Google Play release settings, read by tools/aab.mjs, tools/play-metadata.mjs and .github/workflows/play-yukle.yml. Package names (applicationId) are permanent once an app exists in Play Console: never change them. Optional source: the Vite app the Play build ships when it is not games/<slug> (okcu ships the 3D renderer apps/okcu-3d). Guide: docs/production/play-yayin.md. ios: the App Store build (tools/ipa.mjs): bundle id = applicationId, version = CFBundleShortVersionString, gameCenter.boards = logical board id → App Store Connect leaderboard id (create them with exactly these ids). admob: AdMob (account shellwe28) app ids and the one rewarded ad unit per platform; public ids, they ship inside the apps. platform capacitor = the native adapter with AdMob rewarded ads (tools/admob.mjs; sources on the @oyun/core platform adapter: template games and apps/okcu-3d); web = no ad SDK.

releaseNotes.en-US: First release. Dig thirteen layers for fossils stamped with their true odds, fill your museum and chase the one-in-a-million find.
releaseNotes.tr-TR: İlk sürüm. Gerçek şansı üstünde yazan fosiller için on üç katman kaz, müzeni doldur, milyonda bir gelen bulgunun peşine düş.

releaseNotes.en-US: First release. Fifty one-touch neon levels in five worlds, with Endless, Dive and a daily shaft.
releaseNotes.tr-TR: İlk sürüm. Beş dünyada elli tek dokunuşluk neon bölüm; Sonsuz, Dalış ve günlük kuyu modlarıyla.

releaseNotes.en-US: First release. Knock wobbly 3D archers off their islands across six chapters, with six weapons to level up and two modes, Blitz and Boss Rush.
releaseNotes.tr-TR: İlk sürüm. Altı bölüm boyunca sallanan 3D okçuları adalarından düşür; geliştirilecek altı silah ve iki mod: Yıldırım ve Boss Akını.
